svg.text: One commit changes the app and the pipeline itself: Build -> UpdatePipeline -> Dev -> manual approval -> Prod
AWS CodePipeline - <project>-<env>-cdkp-pipeline (V2, single account, no KMS key)
npm ci, tsc, jest + CDK Nag
pipeline restarts with its new definition
